test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In the Mughal provincial administration, broadly speaking, Diwani meant:

options.text: administration of law and order and criminal justice

solution:
The correct answer is __**revenue administration.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Mughal provincial administration had two main branches - **Nizamat **and **Diwani**.
 
• Broadly speaking, **Nizamat **meant **civil administration** and **Diwani**, **revenue administration**. The provincial subahdar was in charge of **Nizamat **(he was also called Nazim) and the **diwan **was in charge of** revenue administration**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Name of some of the** important departments** during the Mughal administration are :

 
 

 Diwan-i-Wazarat
 Department of revenue & finances
 
 
 
 

 Diwan-i-Arz
 **Military department**
 
 

 Diwan-i-quza
 **Justice department**
 
 

 Diwan-i-Raslatmuhtasib
 **Foreign affairs department**
 
 

 Diwan-i-insha
 **Custodian of govt. papers**
